content: Fail-fast env: lib/env.ts requireEnv(name) that throws at module load is the standard pattern (getLaunchpad 2026-04-08); instrumentation.ts register() runs once at server init (skipped during next build per NEXT_PHASE check) and is the only hook that runs at process start; module-load throw makes dev/build/start fail when the importing server module is compiled; env validated via zod or plain requireEnv
